dashboard.label: Application Health
dashboard.description: Scheduler execution, KV Store readiness, source-state statistics and _internal heartbeat diagnostics for Log Source Watch.

search.query: | lswlicense | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_inventory | where status="active" OR status="maintenance" | stats count AS monitored_sources ] | eval monitored_sources=coalesce(monitored_sources,0), max_sources=tonumber(max_monitored_sources) | eval customer=if(license_status="COMMUNITY","Community",if(isnull(customer) OR len(trim(customer))=0,"—",customer)) | eval capacity_text=if(max_sources<=0,tostring(monitored_sources)." / Unlimited",tostring(monitored_sources)." / ".tostring(max_sources)) | eval utilization=if(max_sources<=0,0,round(monitored_sources/max_sources*100,1)) | eval license_class=case(license_status="EXPIRED" OR license_status="INVALID" OR license_valid=0,"bad",license_status="VALID","good",license_status="COMMUNITY","community",true(),"warn") | eval expires_text=if(isnull(expires_at) OR expires_at="","Not applicable",expires_at), days_text=case(license_status="EXPIRED","Expired",isnull(days_remaining) OR days_remaining="","—",true(),tostring(days_remaining)." days") | eval shc_text=if(shc_allowed=1,"Allowed","Not entitled"), multi_text=if(multiple_search_heads_allowed=1,"Allowed","Not entitled"), msp_text=if(managed_service_allowed=1,"Allowed","Not entitled"), redist_text=if(redistribution_allowed=1,"Allowed","Not entitled") | fields license_status license_valid edition customer license_id capacity_text utilization expires_text days_text shc_text multi_text msp_text redist_text message license_class

error.set: License runtime could not be queried. Restart Splunk after installing or upgrading Log Source Watch, then refresh this page.

div.p: Operational health of scheduled jobs, KV Store state and heartbeat-aware source diagnostics.

search.query: | stats count(eval(health!="OK" AND health!="WAITING FOR SETUP" AND health!="NOT INITIALIZED")) AS value
| eval setup=if(health="WAITING FOR SETUP" OR health="NOT INITIALIZED",1,0) | stats max(setup) AS s | eval value=if(s=1,"SETUP REQUIRED","READY") | fields value

| where component_type="scheduler" | eval Last_run=if(last_run_epoch>0,strftime(last_run_epoch,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),"NO RUN"), Age=if(age_seconds>99999999,"-",round(age_seconds/60,1)." min"), Runtime=if(isnull(runtime_seconds),"-",round(runtime_seconds,2)." s") | rename component AS Component health AS Health scheduler_status AS Scheduler | table Component Health Last_run Age Scheduler Runtime

| where component_type="kvstore" | eval Last_timestamp=if(last_run_epoch>0,strftime(last_run_epoch,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),"-") | rename component AS Collection health AS Health records AS Records | table Collection Health Records Last_timestamp

| inputlookup lsw_inventory | lookup local=true lsw_lastseen _key OUTPUT last_seen updated_at AS lastseen_updated_at | lookup local=true lsw_heartbeat host OUTPUT heartbeat_last_seen heartbeat_updated_at heartbeat_source heartbeat_type | `lsw_calculate_state` | stats count AS Registered sum(eval(effective_state!="RETIRED")) AS Monitored sum(eval(effective_state="OK")) AS OK sum(eval(effective_state="SILENT")) AS Silent sum(eval(effective_state="NO LOG OBSERVATION")) AS "No log" sum(eval(effective_state="MAINTENANCE")) AS Maintenance sum(eval(effective_state="RETIRED")) AS Retired

| inputlookup lsw_inventory | lookup local=true lsw_lastseen _key OUTPUT last_seen updated_at AS lastseen_updated_at | lookup local=true lsw_heartbeat host OUTPUT heartbeat_last_seen heartbeat_updated_at heartbeat_source heartbeat_type | `lsw_calculate_state` | where effective_state!="RETIRED" | stats count(eval(heartbeat_status="ALIVE")) AS "_internal alive" count(eval(heartbeat_status="STALE")) AS "_internal stale" count(eval(heartbeat_status="UNKNOWN" OR isnull(heartbeat_status))) AS "No evidence" count(eval(diagnosis="SOURCE_SILENT_INTERNAL_ACTIVE")) AS "Silent + internal alive" count(eval(diagnosis="SOURCE_SILENT_INTERNAL_STALE")) AS "Silent + internal stale"

html.div: Heartbeat source: LSW correlates exact host values with recent index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd source=*splunkd.log events. Synthetic/demo host names and agentless sources normally show No evidence. Do not generate fake events into _internal; use a real Splunk instance/forwarder host to validate heartbeat correlation.
